entries.title: Psalms 71:1
segments:
PSALM LXXI. 
 
  David wrote this psalm in his old age, of which the former part is   prayer, ver. 1-13.   The latter part, joyful praise and thanksgiving, ver. 14-24.

entries.title: Psalms 71:7
segments: V. 7. A wonder-For my many and sore calamities.

entries.title: Psalms 71:15
segments: V. 15. The numbers-Of thy salvations and mercies vouchsafed to me.

entries.title: Psalms 71:16
segments: V. 16. Make mention-To support and comfort myself with the remembrance of it.  Righteousness-Of thy faithfulness in making good all thy promises.
